FlameLens AI | NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026

Building an AI powered platform to explore NASA’s microgravity combustion research and uncover insights for fire safety in space.

I’m looking for passionate collaborators in AI/ML, web development, data science, space research, and UI/UX. No expert experience required—just curiosity, creativity, and commitment!

Let’s turn space science into actionable intelligence and build something meaningful together.
